cloud_enabled.description: Kill switch. false = local-only mode: no cloud notes request is possible. Consent can never be switched off.

cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model for opt-in redacted notes (Vertex AI / Agent Platform backend).

nano_model_option.description: On-device model option: STABLE, PREVIEW (Gemini Nano 4 Full) or PREVIEW_FAST.

nano_chunk_chars.description: Transcript characters per Gemini Nano request (whole request limit: 4,000 tokens). Clamped to 1000-8000 in the app.

extra_protected_terms.description: Extra words always replaced before a cloud request, e.g. a school's own name. JSON array of strings. Never personal data.
